title: Numerically stable sigmoid, softplus and log-sum-exp
summary: Write sigmoid, softplus, logsumexp and log_softmax so that they give the right answer for inputs of any size, without overflow and without losing small values.

mutants.softplus_naive: Computes log(1 + exp(x)) directly, which overflows for large x and rounds to 0 for very negative x.
mutants.logsumexp_no_shift: Does not subtract the maximum, so exp overflows for large inputs.
mutants.log_of_softmax: Computes the log of the softmax, which gives minus infinity when a probability underflows.
mutants.sigmoid_wrong_sign: Uses exp(x) and not exp(-x) in the positive branch.
mutants.axis_ignored: Always reduces over the last axis and ignores the axis argument.
